## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows nearby project conventions.
- [ ] I ran the smallest relevant verification.
- [ ] I updated public claims or documentation when behavior changed.
- [ ] New assets and dependencies include compatible license/provenance information.
- [ ] Logs, screenshots, and commits contain no credentials or private infrastructure details.
- [ ] Visual changes include an isolated screenshot or short capture where practical.
